description: Symmetry Group Limited is a Pakistani digital technology and experiences company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It works on the digitalisation of marketing, sales and other consumer-facing functions, organised around four areas — transformation, interactive marketing, commerce and mobility — and sells the resulting products through its own brands, including Symmetry Digital, Iris Digital, SymmetryTrade, Corral, Survit, Mobits and Influsense.ai. Its clients are mainly in telecom, banking and finance, FMCG, real estate and pharmaceuticals.
